basic_details.short_information: Kerala Agro Machinery Corporation Ltd. (KAMCO) has 7 one-year Intern vacancies for ITI holders with NCVT certificates. The posts are 5 for Machinist/ Turner/ CNC Operator and 2 for Tractor Mechanic/ Fitter, with a stipend of Rs. 10000/- to 12000/-. Candidates apply online through the Additional Skill Acquisition Programme Kerala (ASAP Kerala) CareerLink portal, paying a non-refundable fee of Rs. 500/-. The last date is 25 October 2026.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for KAMCO Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Applications are online only, through the ASAP Kerala CareerLink portal. The notice gives these steps: Visit the ASAP Kerala CareerLink internship page at careerlink.asapkerala.gov.in/internships/list/IN26041600150. Submit your application on the portal by 25 October 2026. Pay the non-refundable application fee of Rs. 500/- during the registration process. After you register, you will receive further instructions for the screening process.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Selection for the KAMCO internship is through a screening process, as set out in the notice: Each position will have a specific screening process to evaluate candidates' suitability. The screening process may include written tests and interviews. Candidates will be evaluated based on their performance, and a rank list will be published for each position. Registered candidates receive the screening instructions after they complete registration.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: The internship does not guarantee a permanent position. It is limited to the period given in the notification (1 Year). The reported vacancies, final selection and posting orders are at the sole discretion of the organisation providing the internship. ASAP Kerala lists these contacts: email [email protected] ; Head Office phone 04712772500 (10.00AM to 6.00 PM – only on weekdays); course phone numbers +919495999623 and +919495999709 (8.00 AM to 6.00 PM). faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in KAMCO Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 7 internship vacancies: 5 for Machinist/ Turner/ CNC Operator and 2 for Tractor Mechanic/ Fitter.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the KAMCO internship?
faq.answer: The last date to apply is 25 October 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is required for the KAMCO internship?
faq.answer: Candidates must be ITI Holders (NCVT Certificates Holders). This condition covers both posts.

faq.question: Q4. What is the stipend for KAMCO interns?
faq.answer: The notice gives the financial benefit as a stipend of Rs. 10000/- to 12000/-.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application fee for the KAMCO internship?
faq.answer: The application fee is Rs. 500/-. It is non-refundable and is paid during the registration process.

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply for KAMCO Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Apply online on the ASAP Kerala CareerLink page at careerlink.asapkerala.gov.in/internships/list/IN26041600150 and pay the Rs. 500/- fee during registration, by 25 October 2026.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the KAMCO internship?
faq.answer: Each position has its own screening process, which may include written tests and interviews. A rank list will be published for each position based on performance.

faq.question: Q8. Is the KAMCO internship a permanent job?
faq.answer: No. The internship does not guarantee a permanent position and is limited to its 1 Year duration.

faq.question: Q9. Where will KAMCO interns be posted?
faq.answer: Machinist/ Turner/ CNC Operator interns will be posted at Athani/ Kalamassery in Ernakulam. Tractor Mechanic/ Fitter interns will be posted at Athani or Kalamassery in Ernakulam, or at Mala in Thrissur. Final posting orders are at the organisation's discretion.
